title.en: Support for reactive and energetic dogs

text.en: Owners of working breeds, high-energy puppies, and reactive dogs appreciate Missy's thorough understanding of canine psychology. Reviewers report that dogs with fear-based aggression or stranger anxiety build solid confidence, learn healthy boundaries, and enjoy their time throughout training.

Clients consistently commend head trainer Missy for her direct, knowledgeable, and patient approach with both dogs and their handlers. Pet parents emphasise that she not only transforms canine behaviour but also equips families with practical handling techniques for sustained success at home.

Families report remarkable transformations following multi-week residential board-and-train courses. Dogs that previously struggled with leash reactivity, impulse control, or anxiety around young children returned home calm, manageable, and responsive to everyday obedience commands.

q.en: Does the trainer work with dog reactivity and anxiety?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently report substantial progress with dogs showing fear-based reactivity, stranger hesitation, or high arousal.
Yes, reviewers mention six-week and eight-week immersive board-and-train courses hosted in a home training environment.

q.en: Do owners receive guidance on handling skills?

a.en: Yes, clients note that follow-up lessons coach pet parents directly on reinforcing consistency and maintaining habits at home.
